basic_profile.bio: 28-year-old IT professional from Seattle. Passionate about technology, open-source projects, and sustainable living. Enjoys spending weekends hiking and engaging in DIY projects. Currently in a long-term relationship and enjoys quiet evenings at home with their partner. Typically online during late evenings, especially after work hours and sometimes during lunch breaks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and has been working in IT support for the past 5 years. Gained practical knowledge through various online courses and personal projects. Regularly contributes to technology forums and enjoys helping others solve tech-related issues.
